summary: Iteration 48 - PropertyPlug Payout Tracker + Repeat Repair Flags + Statement PDFs end-to-end validation. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (test_iteration48.py) on preview URL covering (a) GET /api/project/payouts returns income {rent_received, expenses, net} and people[] with pct, earned=net*pct/100, paid, balance, payouts[]; (b) POST /api/project/payouts owner-only - acting co-owner gets 403, amount<=0 -> 422, unknown co_owner_id -> 400, bad date 'DD/MM/YYYY' -> 422; (c) DELETE /api/project/payouts/{id} removes the payout; (d) GET /api/my-ownership (co-owner view) exposes earned/paid/balance/payouts per project and totals.paid/totals.balance; (e) GET /api/repairs/history returns repeats[] with room 'Bathroom', count=2, keywords includes 'leak', and items[].repeat=true for the two Bathroom snags, both ids in repeats[0].ids. Frontend (390x844 preview): OWNER home surfaces payouts-panel with payout-person-{cid}, payout-balance-{cid} ('Overpaid £126' when payout > earned), payout-history-{cid} expanding to show 2025-10-15 payout with payout-delete-{pid} removal control, and payout-add-{cid} opening inline form with payout-amount/payout-date/payout-note/payout-save all wired. /repair-history screen renders repeat-flags card with repeat-flag-bathroom ('Bathroom: 2 repairs (2 open) · "leak" Last reported 2026-10-17'), repair-filter-repeat chip toggles correctly, and repair-repeat-{id} REPEAT tag renders on both snag cards. CO-OWNER (fresh registered user with 30% share, £5,000 contribution) /my-ownership shows my-ownership-payout-totals ('£100 paid to you / -£126 paid ahead') and my-ownership-balance-{pid} ('Earned -£26 · paid £100 · paid ahead £126'). After inserting coowner_statements doc with sent:[email] (same iter47 trick, Resend sandbox limitation), my-statement-{pid}-2024 chip expanded my-statement-detail-{pid}-2024 panel with Rent received/Property expenses/Net income/Share of estimated profit/Your capital contribution rows plus whole-property summary, and my-statement-pdf-{pid}-2024 button clicked without crash (expo-print window.print path). CLEANUP: all seed removed (co_owners doc, user, ownership_shares, 1 payout, 2 snags, 1 coowner_statements) - verified empty response from /api/co-owners and /api/project/payouts after teardown.
action_items: No code changes required. Payout Tracker, Repeat Repair Flags and Statement PDFs all work end-to-end on preview backend + Expo web frontend.

Known preview-only behaviour (same as iter47): Resend sandbox only delivers to delivered@resend.dev - to verify co-owner UI surfaces statements, test inserts coowner_statements doc directly in Mongo with sent:[email]. The owner-side POST /api/project/statements path still ran correctly in iter47 so no code gap.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ownership.py:211-223 payout_ledger computes earned = net * pct / 100 and balance = earned - paid - matches the UI 'Owed/Overpaid/All square' logic exactly (payouts-panel.tsx:50-52).

routes/ownership.py:238-251 add_payout: real_id guard gives 403 for acting co-owners, _people() ensures co_owner_id must be a known invitee of this project, date validated by pydantic regex AND date.fromisoformat; amount Field(gt=0) returns 422 for 0 and negatives.

routes/ownership.py:204-208 net_income_to_date iterates ALL rent_payments.paid_amount and ALL rental_expenses.amount for this project (no tax-year filter), which matches 'all-time' semantics the spec requires.

routes/ownership_views.py:48-49 /my-ownership returns payouts without co_owner_id in the per-project list (keeps only id/amount/date/note), while totals.paid and totals.balance sum across projects - verified in UI.

routes/snags.py:367-387 _repeats uses created_at >= 365-day cutoff + lowercase room group; keywords extracted via STOP+ISSUE_WORDS sort so 'leak' consistently floats to the top when it recurs - verified with 'Leak under sink' + 'Leak behind toilet'.
frontend/src/components/payouts-panel.tsx:34 - 'if (!d?.people.length) return null' means the panel is only visible when at least one co-owner has a share; good UX for owner-only projects.
frontend/app/repair-history.tsx:55 - testID uses `repeat-flag-${room.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')}` which matches 'repeat-flag-bathroom' expectation.
frontend/app/my-ownership.tsx:97 - PDF button safely wrapped in catch -> toast on failure; verified no crash when window.print path runs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - owner payouts-panel (person/balance/history/add/form/delete), repair-history (repeat-flags/filter/tags) and co-owner my-ownership (payout totals/balance/statement detail/PDF button) all verified on preview 390x844

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Backend login JSON uses 'access_token'. Login UI: click 'Sign in' text on landing then fill 2 inputs and press Enter (NOT the Sign in button - there are two with the same text). Payouts panel only renders on home when at least one co-owner has a share AND the user is the owner (not acting as co-owner). To test co-owner statement visibility against any email besides delivered@resend.dev, insert into Mongo coowner_statements with sent:[email] - the UI will then surface my-statement-{pid}-{year} chip. Pytest invocation needs -o addopts="" to avoid the xdist default from backend/pytest.ini breaking collection on this test file. test_iteration48.py has module-level BASE_URL assert - run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> prefix.
